top.title: Chicken Soup

evidence: Put all the ingredients... in a large stockpot

ingredients: 2 small or 1 large boiling or roasting chicken
directions: 1 recipe Matzo Balls, recipe follows
Put all the ingredients, except the matzo balls, in a large stockpot, cover abundantly with water, and bring to a boil.
Skim to remove all the gray scum that will float to the surface, then let cook at a simmer for about 3 hours.
Just keep tasting: when the broth tastes golden and chickeny, it's ready.
Remove the chicken and, if you like, leave the soup to get cold to you can remove any fat that collects on the surface.
That way you can accrue some schmaltz, too.
Reheat the stock, and serve it as a plain soup, or add a few carrot sticks - from about 2 carrots, say - and cook in the soup, adding some torn-up pieces of chicken to warm through at the end.
I like to add freshly chopped parsley.
(You can also cook the Matzo Balls in the soup as well while it's heating up again.)
1 egg
2 tablespoons schmaltz, margarine or butter, melted
3 tablespoons water or soup stock
Scant 1/2 cup medium matzo meal
Pinch salt and a grind of pepper
Whisk the egg in a large-ish bowl, then whisk in the melted schmaltz (or whatever).

Carry on whisking as you add the water or soup stock, the matzo meal and salt and pepper, and mix together into a rough paste; if it's too stiff to feel that it might be malleable later, add a little more water.
Put in the refrigerator to chill for 1 hour (or leave overnight if you wish) then dip out small lumps of paste and roll them into walnut-sized balls between the palms of your hands.
Cook the dumplings in boiling, salted water and simmer for about 40 minutes (you can just cook them directly in the soup, but I'll do anything to preserve its unstarchy clearness).
They are cooked when they rise to the surface.
Add to the soup, and ladle out generously into waiting bowls.
Yield: makes about 20

ingredients: 1 can Spam, cut according to preference

directions: 1. Bring a large pot to a boil (about 6 cups of water) and place kimchi and sauce ingredients (gochujang, gochugaru, minced garlic, soy sauce, sugar, and diced onion). Boil for about 10 minutes to soften the kimchi and enrich the broth.

2. Meanwhile, prepare the meats by cutting them into desired pieces. Add the pre-cut bacon and hot dog (Spam if available) and cook for another 10 minutes. Follow that with the instant ramen noodles and wait until noodles separate on their own.

3. When noodles have separated, taste the broth of the stew and regulate according to taste preference. This might be too spicy for some so reducing the red pepper paste and flakes or adding extra water will help alleviate this problem.
4. Serve immediately before noodles soften and set at the center of the table where everyone can help themselves, or plate individually into separate bowls. Eat with rice and banchan side dishes.
*Many Koreans will also include some of the spicy sauce packet from the instant noodles (Shin Ramen being the most ideal) that can surprisingly add more depth and flavor to the stew.

top.title: Stuffed bread
directions: You start out with the two French Bread loaves.
You need to slice the bread in half from end to end, so that you have a top and bottom half.
Think a large sub bun.
You need to hull out the bread.
Take a fork and slowly pull the inside of the loaves out.
Be careful not to break through to the outside of the bread.
You do not need to have it paper-thin either.
The goal is to make a large hollow opening in the loaf.
The bread you pulled out needs to be broken up into small pieces.
Preheat oven to 375F
Next, you need to brown the hamburger and the sausage.
Pretend you are cooking tacos.
You can brown the beef and the sausage together if you like.
Once the meat is brown, make sure you have it chopped up in the small pieces and also make sure you drain it.
In a large bowl combine your bread pieces that you hulled out of the loves along with your browned hamburger and sausage plus the cheese.
All of the cheese.
Stir all of it together or do as I do and use your hands to mix together.
You now need to add milk.
The amount of milk you add will depend on how dry the bread is.
Start out with 1-cup.
The goal is to add just enough milk to get the bread mushy enough that everything sticks together.
Once your filling is mixed then you spoon the mixture into the bottom halves of the two bread loaves.
Remember you have the top to cover it and you need to press it in.
Make sure it is tightly packed.
Place the tops on the loaves and wrap each loaf tightly in aluminum foil.
I prefer to double wrap them.
Stick them in the oven for one hour.
You are basically melting all the cheese and heating everything together.
After the hour pull them out of the oven and let them sit for at least 30 mins.
Slice off a piece as thick as you want and chow down.

top.title: Vegetable Soup

evidence: Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

directions: Brown ground beef, onions and garlic.
Pour spaghetti sauce into Dutch oven.
Add beef broth, 2 cups water, celery, sugar, salt, beef and onions; bring to a boil.
Simmer 45 minutes. Add vegetables and tomatoes.
Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

top.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cook rice; cut out stem portion top of pepper (carefully); clean out inside, washing out seeds with water.
Pot boil peppers 5 minutes; place upside-down to rinse and drain.
Saute onions, celery and chorizo.
Add spices.
Brown hamburg.
In separate pan, brown pork.
Drain grease and original mixture. Put mixture in bowl.
Remove with spoon or fork, don't take grease.
Add 1 mashed hard-boiled egg and 1 raw beaten egg.
Add cooked rice.
When peppers cool stuff gently.
Bake in casserole (greased with margarine, add little water), uncovered, about 1 hour at 350°. Can put pepper top back on like little hat.

top.title: Indian Rice Curry
ingredients: freshly ground black pepper to taste
directions: Heat the oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and saute for 3 minutes. Add the apple and saute for 3 more minutes. Add the curry powder and cayenne and coat the apple and the onion.
Add the cooked rice and chickpeas. Cook through until the rice and beans are hot. Sprinkle with lemon juice and serve.

top.title: Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 cut up chicken, skinned or 6 thighs and 3 breasts, cooked
directions: Saute onion in butter.
Add curry powder and stir in flour. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, then add chopped garlic and green pepper. (Mixture will be very thick.)
Add chicken broth and evaporated milk.
Simmer slowly until thickened (about 15 to 20 minutes). Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add chicken.
Serve over rice.
Suggested condiments:
chopped eggs, bacon bits and peanuts.
Sauce without the chicken added freezes well.

top.title: Lamb Curry
directions: Marinade Lamb overnight
Cook onion in oil until light brown
Add paste and cook until you can smell the aroma of the spices
Add tomatoes and chilli powder and stir
Add lamb and marinade and casserole for about 2 hours
6.	Add potatoes and carrot half way through cooking time
Cover and cook at low flame till done

top.title: Curried Corn Soup
directions: Melt oleo in pan.
Add curry powder and stir until smooth. Add onion then corn, stirring slowly.
Then add cream.
Heat through.

top.title: Minced Meat Curry
ingredients: 500 grams Minced meat (this time, I used beef and pork)
directions: Chop the onion into fine and rough pieces.
Heat oil in a frying pan and fry the onion from Step 1 over high heat.
When the onion is transparent, add honey and fry over high heat (be careful not to burn it) until it changes colour.
Add meat, curry powder, and salt and pepper to Step 2 and fry until the meat has cooked thoroughly.
Add canned tomatoes and soup stock, and simmer over low heat for around 15 minutes.
If there isn't enough water, add around 100 ml.
Add curry roux and cream cheese and simmer.
Adjust the amount of roux to suit the texture and taste you want.
Taste, add salt if necessary, and it's done.

top.title: Fast Goodies
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Spoon into greased miniature muffin pans.
Bake at 450 for 10-12 minutes.
Yield: About 48.

top.title: Garlic, Cheese & Sausage Bites

evidence: spicy Italian turkey sausage or 6 ounces spicy Italian pork sausage

ingredients: 6 ounces spicy Italian turkey sausage or 6 ounces spicy Italian pork sausage
directions: Preheat the oven to 375. Cut the top off the head of garlic and place it on a baking sheet covered with foil and pour olive oil over it. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until golden brown and cloves are soft & mushy. (this can also be done in the toaster oven :O)
Cut the raw sausage open and throw away the sausage casing, brown the sausage in a skillet until completely cooked.
Chop 1-2 cloves raw garlic, about 1 1/2 teaspoons.

In a large bowl combine cooked sausage, cream cheese, roasted garlic, raw garlic a pinch of red chili flakes, and seasoning- I just shook in a bit of the garlic powder, garlic salt, & pepper (probably around 1/4 tsp each, maybe a bit more) and mix with a hand held electric mixer until all ingredients are well combined.

Spray a mini-muffin tin with non-stick cooking spray. Add a won-ton wrapper one cup of the muffin tray and fill with about 1 to 1 1/2 Tbsp of the garlic cheese mix. Pinch the won ton wrapper together to seal, then spray with non-stick cooking spray, repeat until the whole tin is full of lil' garlic bites!
Bake at 375 for about 30 minutes or until they are golden brown and gorgeous!
The tops will open up a bit- but I thought they were reminiscent of little garlic cloves and was happy with how they came out.

top.title: Snappy Bites
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Pinch off small pieces of dough and shape into 3/4-inch balls.
Place on baking sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes 8 dozen.
Freezes well.

top.title: Crispy Cheese Squares
directions: In bowl combine butter with cheese.
Blend in flour and cayenne pepper.
Mix in cereal.
Press into a buttered 8 or 9-inch cake pan.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp.
Cool and cut into bars.

top.title: Hot Diggety Dogs
directions: Place crackers on a lightly greased
. Top with cheese, ketchup, mustard and relish. Cut each hot dog into 10 slices; place one slice on each cracker. Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

top.title: Peanut Butter Gooddess

evidence: 2 cups Turkey Hill Peanut Butter Cup Ice Cream
2 cups Turkey Hill Peanut Butter Cup Ice Cream

ingredients: 2 cups Turkey Hill Peanut Butter Cup Ice Cream
directions: Bake a batch of Ghirardelli Brownies. Put the Tagalong cookies in the batter before you place in oven. Be sure to space the cookies out so when you cut the brownies, each square gets a cookie. I know this recipe says serves one, but this is where you share-- well kind of. Bake the brownies, share the love but be sure to put one (or two...) aside for your beautiful dessert coming up.
Take a brownie with a full cookie and put in microwave for 45 seconds
Put 2 cups of ice cream on top of the brownie
Squish the Nutter Butter cookies and sprinkle on top of bowl
Mix the nutella and PB and throw throughout your bowl
If you can bare to wait before diving into the beautiful PB heaven, put a TBS of PB in the microwave for 45 seconds and then drizzle on top. Viola, enjoy!

top.title: Chocolate Lover'S Delight
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix (do not use pudding in the mix brands)
directions: Make cake mix per directions on box.
Bake.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Use end of wooden spoon and poke holes in cake.
Add sweetened milk and caramel topping.
Put in fridge.
When ready to eat, top with Cool Whip and crushed candy bar.

top.title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Combine pudding mix, cake mix, chocolate chips, milk and eggs in large bowl.
Mix by hand until well blended, about 2 minutes. Fold in nuts.

top.title: Unbridled Sin!

evidence: 16 crushed macaroons or chocolate cookie wafers

ingredients: 16 crushed macaroons or chocolate cookie wafers
directions: Layer 1/2 crushed macaroons or chocolate cookie wafers, mixed with one stick melted oleo, chocolate ice cream, 1/2 fudge sauce, more cookie mixture, 1/2 Heath bars (crushed), coffee ice cream, more fudge sauce and more crushed Heath bars.
Keep in freezer until ready to serve.
This works well in a spring-form pan.

top.title: Chocolates With Hot Chocolate Shots
directions: Arrange a small selection of your favorite chocolates on serving plates.

For the hot chocolate shots, place semi-sweet chocolate in medium bowl. Combine milk, cream and coffee liqueur in small saucepan. Heat without boiling. Pour over chocolate. Let stand 1 min; stir until smooth. Pour into espresso cups or shot glasses; serve with chocolates.

top.title: Slow-Cooked Corned Beef

evidence: Cover and cook on low for 9-11 hours

ingredients: 2 corned beef briskets with spice packets (3 pounds each)
directions: In a 6-qt. slow cooker, combine the potatoes, carrots and onion. Add briskets (discard spice packets from corned beef or save for another use). Sprinkle the brown sugar, sugar, coriander and peppercorns over meat. Pour water over top.
Cover and cook on low for 9-11 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender.
Remove meat and vegetables to a serving platter. Thinly slice one brisket across the grain and serve with vegetables. Save the remaining brisket for Reuben Strata (
) or save for another use.

top.title: Tender Texas Style Steaks

evidence: Cover and cook on high for 3 hours and then on low for 3 hours.

directions: Lay steaks on bottom of crock pot.
Combine sugar & ketchup and pour over steaks.
If steaks are layered make sure each one is covered with sauce.
Sprinkle salt & pepper and dashes of W-shire.
Cover and cook on high for 3 hours and then on low for 3 hours.

top.title: Slow Cooker Beef Barbecue
directions: Place beef in 5 qt slow cooker.
Combine tomato sauce, next 5 ingrediants, and if disired cinnamon and cloves; pour over beef.
Cook on low for 9 hours.
Remove beef from slow cooker; shred with two forks.
Return beef to slow cooker, and stir into sauce.
Serve on buns.

top.title: Barbecue(Slow Cooker)

evidence: Cook all in slow cooker on high 8 hours or on low for 12 to 16 hours.

directions: Brown beef or roast.
Cook all in slow cooker on high 8 hours or on low for 12 to 16 hours.
Use wire whisk until meat shreds. Serve on buns or over potatoes.

top.title: Slow Cooker Beef Carbonnade

evidence: In 12-inch skillet, heat oil on medium-high until very hot.
Add beef chunks to skillet in 3 batches, and cook 5-6 minutes per batch or until well browned on all sides, stir

ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck, well-trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks
2 large onions, cut in half and thinly sliced
1 garlic clove, crushed with side of chef's knife
1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped and loosely packed
directions: In 12-inch skillet, heat oil on medium-high until very hot.
In large bowl, combine beef chunks, flour, 1/2 t salt, and 1/4 t freshly ground black pepper; toss to coat beef evenly.
Add beef chunks to skillet in 3 batches, and cook 5-6 minutes per batch or until well browned on all sides, stirring occasionally and adding more oil if necessary.
With slotted spoon, transfer beef to medium bowl once it is browned.
After all beef is browned, add broth to skillet and heat to boiling on high, stirring to loosen any browned bits.
Boil 1 minute, stirring.
Meanwhile, in 6 to 6 1/2 quart slow cooker bowl, stir together sliced onions, garlic, beer and thyme.
Top with browned beef, any juices in bowl, and broth mixture from skillet; do not stir.
Cover slow cooker with lid, and cook as manufacturer directs on low setting for 8 hours.
About 20 minutes before beef mixture is done, prepare egg noodles as label directs.
To serve, skim and discard any fat from cooking liquid.
Divide noodles evenly among serving bowls; spoon beef mixture and sauce over noodles, and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Makes about 10 cups.

top.title: Chicken Soup
directions: Combine chicken and water in saucepan.
Bring to a boil; cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken from broth; reserve 3 cups of broth. Reserve remaining broth for another use, if desired.
Let chicken cool; cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Skim fat from broth.

top.title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook 1 bag of frozen broccoli in 1 1/2 cups water; dissolve 4 chicken bouillon cubes to make 1 1/2 cups chicken broth.
Add 1 stick oleo; simmer 1/2 hour.
Add 1 can evaporated milk; add 1 cup water.
Season with salt and/or pepper.
Thicken with cornstarch or flour.
Add cheese or croutons before serving.

top.title: Chicken in a Pot

evidence: Bring to a boil over med-high heat

ingredients: 1 (3 -4 lb) whole chickens, trimmed of excess fat, rinsed and patted dry with paper towels
2 large carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
2 leeks, split, trimmed, cleaned, cut into 2-inch lengths
directions: Put chicken in a large stockpot with the stock, onion, carrots, and leeks.
Bring to a boil over med-high heat, then immediately decrease heat to medium-low.
Skim foam from the surface if needed.
Add in the bay leaf, allspice, peppercorns, and thyme to the pot with some salt and pepper.
Simmer about 45 minutes, until the chicken and vegetables are nearly tender and the chicken is cooked through.
With 15 minutes of cooking time remaining, preheat the oven to 200.
When the chicken is done, use a slotted spoon to remove it and the vegetables to an ovenproof platter and place the platter in the oven.
Increase heat to high and boil the stock until it reduces by about 25 percent, 10-15 minutes.
Strain the stock into a big bowl and adjust seasoning as needed.

Serve the soup as a first course, garnished with parsley, followed by the chicken and vegetables, or cut up the chicken and serve in deep bowls with the broth and the vegetables; garnish with parsley.

top.title: Granny's Broth (Cawl Mam-gu) Welsh

evidence: Put the meat into the saucepan, cover with cold water

ingredients: 2 lbs best end of neck welsh lamb
directions: Put the meat into the saucepan, cover with cold water, add salt and pepper, bring slowly to the boil and skin carefully.
(This can be done the night before and the fat allowed to set on the surface.
This makes it easier to skim off.)
Then add the carrots (cut in half), the swede (sliced) and the white of the leeks, and simmer gently for 2 - 2 1/2 hours.
Add the potatoes (cut in four) and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.
When the potatoes are almost cooked, thicken with flour and a little water.
Lastly, add the green of the leeks and parsley (chopped) and simmer for further 10 minutes and serve in basins while hot.
Cawl was the dish most commonly served for dinner on the farm during the winter months in th ecounties of South and West Wales.
The broth itself would be served in basins or bowls, with bread, and the meat and vegetables served as a second course.

top.title: Boiler Broth - Early 1900'S
directions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Pat the skin of the chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Stuff onion into the cavity and then tie legs together with kitchen string and then bake for 30 minutes.
Peel the carrot and roughly chop the leek and celery.
Place the chicken and remaining ingredients into a large pot and cover with water and bring to the boil and skim off any scum that forms and then cover and simmer very gently for up to 5 hours.
It will make your house smell wonderful.
Strain into a large bowl and allow to cool.
Chill overnight and then skim off fat that forms on the surface, use within 3 days or freeze.

SERVING SUGGESTIONS - the rich flavour of the wonderful broth makes a meal in itself, shred meat from the breast and throw in a handful of noodles and fresh herbs for a bowl of sublime chicken noodle soup.

top.title: Spicy Soba Noodles
ingredients: 12 cup light brown sugar, firmly packed
directions: Bring a large kettle of salted water to a boil.
Meanwhile, prepare the sauce.
In a small saucepan heat together the soy sauce, brown sugar, tahini, garlic, and red pepper, whisking until the sugar and tahini melt.
Stir in the sesame oil and scallions and keep warm.
When the water boils at the soba and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Drain.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, serve immediately.

top.title: Spicy mushroom egg noodles
directions: A quick snapshot of the ingredients.
In a large pot soak the egg noodles for 3minutes.

Heat the pan and stir fry the ingredients for 4minutes.
Do not overcook.
Heat another pan and fry the eggs.
Slowly add the noodles, splash in soy sauce and chilli sauce, add the chopped fried eggs, flavor with salt and pepper.
Stir fry for couple of minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy my very own spicy mushroom egg noodles.

over low heat blend the flavors until warm.

mix well until warm.
then add cooked noodles,toss well to coat all the flavors.
serve with the soy sauce.
enjoy!

top.title: Spicy Beef Chow Mein
ingredients: 1/2 pound top round or sirloin beef, thinly sliced
Kosher or sea salt, to taste
Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste
1 cup snow peas (about 4 ounces), sliced in half lengthwise
directions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
Rinse under cold water, drain and set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine the soy sauce, oyster sauce, chile-garlic sauce, hoisin, rice vinegar, brown sugar and water.
Set sauce mixture aside.
Heat a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the oil and then add the beef.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook until browned, about 30 seconds each side.
Stir in the garlic, onion and ginger.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the garlic and onions are soft and fragrant.
Stir in the cabbage and snow peas.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the noodles and sauce mixture.
Toss everything together until combined and heated through, about 2 minutes.
Serve hot.

top.title: Spicy Shrimp And Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
directions: Cook pasta according to the package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain.

Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add red pepper and garlic to pan; saute 1 minute. Add shrimp; saute 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes and next 4 ingredients (through salt); bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in pasta; cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated.
Place 1 1/2 cups pasta mixture on each of 4 plates; top each serving with 1 tablespoon cheese. Serve immediately.

We used dried basil in this dish to cut costs, but you can substitute 2 tablespoons fresh basil, if desired. Frozen or previously frozen shrimp is often on sale at supermarkets. Total cost: $8.30/Cost per serving: $2.08. (The cost is based on the amount of products used in the recipe.)

Pour lime mixture into freezer container of a 4-quart ice-cream maker; freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Garnish each serving, if desired.

Refreshing Lemon Sherbet: Substitute a large lemon for the lime and fresh lemon juice for lime juice. Proceed as directed. Garnish with fresh mint sprigs, thinly sliced lemon wedges, and lemon rind strips.

Melt butter in an 8" x 8" baking pan while oven is heating.

directions: Cook sugar, flour, eggs and milk which have been mixed until they boil.
Strain through colander into freezer can.
Add vanilla to taste, salt and Pet milk.
Fill can up with milk. Place in refrigerator until cool and freeze.
You can use fruit or chocolate to basic recipe.
You can use 2% milk to make.

top.title: Fruited Freeze

lemon flavored chiffon pie filling mix

top.title: Creamy Comfort Chicken

evidence: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil
Heat oil in small sauteed p

Add rice.
Bring back to a boil.
Cover.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Let steam 5 minutes.
Remove the lid and fluff rice.
Leave uncovered for two minutes.
Cover to retain heat.

Variations; Cheddar, beer, broccoli, bell pepper, celery, basil, mashed potatoes, noodles

top.title: Corned Beef Hash British Style

evidence: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and cubed
1 (12 ounce) can corned beef, broken into pieces
directions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Place the potatoes in a large pot with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and mash, flavoring with milk, butter, salt or however you like to make them.

Pour the baked beans into the bottom of a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Slice the corned beef and arrange on top of the beans in an even layer. Season with a few dashes of Worcestershire sauce. Top with mashed potatoes.

Bake uncovered for 25 minutes in the preheated oven. The mashed potatoes should start to crisp up but not yet brown. Top with the cheese and return to the oven. Bake for another 20 minutes, or until cheese is browned.

top.title: Crumpets
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Dissolve yeast in water.
Beat eggs; add milk, butter, salt and sugar.
Add yeast mixture and flour, beating until smooth and well blended.
Cover and set aside in warm place for 15 minutes.

top.title: Old Fashioned Dumplings
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Add 1/2 cup chicken broth and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened.
Turn dough out on a floured surface and form into a ball.
Roll dough 1/16 inch thickness, cut into 5x1 inch strips.
Drop into boiling broth.
Cover and cook 15 minutes until dumplings are tender.
May add 1 or 2 tbsp. butter and stir to thicken.
Add cooked chicken.

top.title: Old-Fashioned Bread Pudding

directions: Heat milk until skin forms on top.
Pour over bread crumbs; add margarine and raisins.
Let cool.
Beat eggs slightly and mix with sugar, salt and spice.
Mix in cooled crumb mixture.
Pour in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
To test for doneness, insert a knife in the center.
It should come out clean.
The bread pudding can also be baked in a large loaf pan.

top.title: Japanese Chestnut Rice
ingredients: 2 cups Japanese sweet rice (Japanese measuring cup)
1 cup Regular Japanese rice (Japanese measuring cup)
directions: Cook the fresh chestnuts and peel off the skins.
I normally boil them first for 3 minutes and then I roast them in the oven for 5 more minutes.
Wash the Japanese sweet rice and regular rice put it into the bowl for the rice cooker.
Add soy sauce, mirin, salt, water, cooked chestnuts.
Turn on the rice cooker.
About 20 minutes later, it looks like this.
Mix it and you are ready to serve.

top.title: Udon(Japanese Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless pork, chicken or shrimp
snow peas or Chinese pea pods
directions: Cook Udon noodles in a large pot of boiling water until tender.

top.title: Japanese Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 packages Japanese curry, lots of choices (suggested Vermont spicy hot).
directions: Add olive oil to large deep skillet.
Chop onion and cook in oil for about 5 minutes than add in cubed chicken.
Once chicken is mostly cooked art seasoning salt, carrots and potatoes.
All cut into bit size pieces.
Add water bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Uncover, mix in curry cubes and remove from heat.
In that order.
let it thicken for 20 minutes stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

top.title: Simple Perfect Oden
directions: Slice the daikon radish into 2 cm rounds and peel the skin.
Score a cross and boil until a skewer pierces through easily.
Boil the eggs completely.
Slice the konnyaku to 1 cm and thread the end through the hole to make a "rein knot."
Blanch in the leftover water from boiling the eggs.
Pour boiled water from the daikon over the fish paste items to drain excess water.
Add the ingredients marked with to the heated soup stock.
Add the daikon radish, eggs, and konnyaku, and simmer on low heat.
After 35 minutes have passed, add the chikuwa.
After another 5 minutes, add the other fish paste items.
After adding all the fish paste items, boil for 5 minutes.
Turn off the heat and cool.
To make the rein-knot konnyaku, cut a 2 cm hole in the center of the sliced konnyaku and thread one side through the hole, as seen in the photo in Step 2.
If you make your own dashi soup stock, you can use kombu seaweed.
Save the kombu used to make the stock and after the oden has been simmering for 20 minutes, add it in.

top.title: Japanese-Style Simmered Shrimp and Nagaimo Yam with Tomatoes
directions: Devein the peeled shrimp, if necessary.
Rub in the prepping ingredients (sake and katakuriko), and rinse the shrimp.
Peel the nagaimo yam, and cut into 1 cm slices (either whole or after cutting the yam in half lengthwise first).
Chop the tomato coarsely.
Finely mince the garlic.
Heat oil in a frying pan.
Add garlic and saute over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the nagaimo yam and saute until it's starting to turn translucent - about 3 minutes.
Add the peeled and cleaned shrimp and mix, then add the sake and tomato.
Cover with a lid and simmer over low heat for about 5 minutes.
Dissolve the miso.
Taste, and add salt and pepper to taste, and turn off the heat.
Transfer to a serving plate.
Optionally, add chopped green onion (not listed) on top.
